description: This file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application, which manages core app lifecycle events, permissions, UI setup with Jetpack Compose, and some background services.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Primary activity managing app lifecycle, permissions, UI rendering, and background services.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI, permissions, and background coroutines.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Handles actions when the activity becomes visible, sets foreground state.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the activity is no longer in the foreground, clears foreground state.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles new intents received by the activity, including assistant launch requests.

methods.name: handleAssistantIntent
methods.description: Processes assistant launch intents and passes them to the ViewModel.
